item.title: Yonezawa Beef: One of Japan's Three Great Wagyu — Guide
item.description: Yonezawa beef is one of Japan’s three great wagyu brands alongside Matsusaka and Kobe, prized for its extraordinary fat marbling, buttery texture and delicate sweetness. Cattle raised in the Okitama basin are fed on local rice straw and pure mountain water, producing meat so tender it dissolves on the tongue. Specialty yakiniku and sukiyaki houses in Yonezawa City serve the full spectrum of cuts. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Yonezawa, Yamagata Hours Restaurant hours Admission Premium; varies by cut Time needed About 1.
